name: Spotify
label: Spotify Web API — search, tracks, playlists, player
description: Official Spotify Web API at https://api.spotify.com/v1. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Auth is OAuth bearer access_token minted outside StudioQuack. Feb 2026 search: limit default 5, max 10. Customer owns the Spotify app and grant. Never log tokens. Docs: https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/web-api
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. search needs q + type (limit, market optional). track_get needs track_id. playlist_get / playlist_add need playlist_id; playlist_add also needs uris. player_state has no extra fields. Do not put access_token here. Example: {"operation":"search","q":"radiohead","type":"track","limit":5}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: search | track_get | playlist_get | playlist_add | player_state | trigger.

schema.label: q
schema.description: Search query for search (GET /search). Required with type. Example: 'radiohead'.

schema.label: type
schema.description: Spotify search type(s) for search. Comma-separated: album, artist, playlist, track, show, episode, audiobook. Required. Example: 'track'.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Search page size. Spotify (Feb 2026): default 5, maximum 10. This node forwards the value; Spotify 400s above 10. Example: 5.

schema.label: market
schema.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 market for search. Optional. Example: 'US'.

schema.label: track_id
schema.description: Spotify track id for track_get (GET /tracks/{track_id}). Example: '11dFghVXANMlKmJXsNCbNl'.

schema.label: playlist_id
schema.description: Playlist id for playlist_get and playlist_add. Example: '3cEYpjA9oz9GiPac4AsH4n'.

schema.label: uris
schema.description: Spotify track/episode URIs for playlist_add. Required. Example: ["spotify:track:4iV5W9uYEdYUVa79Axb7Rh"].

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). trigger returns the BPMN message-event instruction — it does not open a socket. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx. player_state may be HTTP 204 with empty data when nothing is playing.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON (search page, Track, Playlist, snapshot, or playback state).

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: search | track_get | playlist_get | playlist_add | player_state | trigger.

configurationParameters.label: OAuth access token
configurationParameters.description: Spotify OAuth access token minted outside StudioQuack (StudioQuack secret). Sent as Authorization: Bearer. playlist_add needs playlist-modify-public or playlist-modify-private; player_state needs user-read-playback-state. Never log or place on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Q
configurationParameters.description: Search query for search (GET /search). Required with type. Example: 'radiohead'.

configurationParameters.label: Limit
configurationParameters.description: Search page size. Spotify (Feb 2026): default 5, maximum 10. This node forwards the value; Spotify 400s above 10. Example: 5.

configurationParameters.label: Market
configurationParameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 market for search. Optional. Example: 'US'.

configurationParameters.label: Type
configurationParameters.description: Spotify search type(s) for search. Comma-separated: album, artist, playlist, track, show, episode, audiobook. Required. Example: 'track'.

configurationParameters.label: Track ID

configurationParameters.label: Playlist ID

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
